content:
You are an AI architect. Decompose this goal into concrete implementation tasks.

Goal: Build Pixel Jump & Run Game
Description: Build a complete pixel-art style Jump & Run platformer game as a single HTML file. Features: player character with pixel sprite, multiple obstacle types (spikes, gaps, moving platforms, enemies), collectible rewards (coins, gems, power-ups), unlockable skins system, XP and leveling system with skill upgrades (double jump, dash, shield), scrolling levels with increasing difficulty, score tracking, dark pixel-art theme, smooth controls with arrow keys/WASD, game over and restart flow.

For each task, provide:
1. A clear, actionable title
2. Type (feature/bug/docs/test/refactor/chore)
3. Brief description of what needs to be done
4. Dependencies on other tasks (if any)

Create 3-7 tasks that together accomplish the goal. Format each as:
- **Task Title** (type) — Description

Here are the implementation tasks to build the Pixel Jump & Run Game:

— **Set up HTML canvas, game loop, and pixel-art rendering engine** (feature) — Create the single HTML file with embedded CSS/JS. Set up a 800x400 canvas with a pixel-art dark theme. Implement the core game loop (requestAnimationFrame), camera/viewport scrolling system, and a pixel-art sprite rendering utility that draws characters and objects using small filled rectangles. Include grid-based coordinate system with a 16px base tile size.

— **Implement player character with physics and controls** (feature) — Create the player character as a pixel-art sprite (16x24 px). Implement gravity, jumping (with variable jump height based on key hold duration), horizontal movement with acceleration/deceleration, and ground detection. Support arrow keys and WASD. Add running animation frames (at least idle, run-left, run-right, jump). Implement coyote time (brief grace period to jump after leaving a platform edge). Dependencies: Task 1

— **Build level system with platforms, terrain, and scrolling** (feature) — Create a tile-based level system with solid platforms, ground tiles, and gaps. Implement side-scrolling camera that follows the player. Build a level generator that creates procedurally generated levels with increasing difficulty (wider gaps, more obstacles per section). Add at least 3 distinct visual tile types (grass, stone, ice). Store level data as 2D arrays. Dependencies: Task 1, Task 2

— **Add obstacles and enemies** (feature) — Implement multiple obstacle types: static spikes (instant kill), moving platforms (horizontal and vertical), crumbling platforms (break after standing on them briefly), and enemy NPCs that patrol back and forth on platforms. Enemies should be pixel-art sprites with simple walk animation. Player can defeat enemies by jumping on top of them (Mario-style). Contact from the side causes damage. Dependencies: Task 2, Task 3

— **Implement collectibles, rewards, and power-ups** (feature) — Add collectible coins (scattered throughout levels, +10 XP each), gems (rare, +50 XP), and power-up items: speed boost (temporary 1.5x speed), shield (absorbs one hit), and magnet (attracts nearby coins). Each collectible should have a pixel-art sprite and a pickup animation (scale + fade). Track total coins collected per run. Dependencies: Task 3

— **Build XP, leveling, skills, and skins system** (feature) — Implement an XP bar and leveling system (XP thresholds: 100, 250, 500, 1000, 2000). Each level-up grants a skill point. Unlockable skills: Double Jump (level 2), Dash (level 3, quick horizontal burst on shift key), Shield Start (level 5, start each run with a shield). Build a skins system with 5 unlockable player skins (default, ninja, robot, wizard, golden) unlocked at levels 1/2/3/4/5. Add a main menu / character select screen. Persist XP, level, unlocked skills, and skins using localStorage. Dependencies: Task 2, Task 5

— **Add HUD, score tracking, game over, menus, and polish** (feature) — Build the heads-up display showing: current score, coins collected, XP bar, current level, active power-ups with timers, and current skin name. Implement game-over screen with final score, XP earned, and restart button. Add a start screen with title, "Play" button, and skin selector. Add screen shake on enemy kill, particle effects for coin pickup, and smooth transitions between menus and gameplay. Include speed progression (game scrolls faster over time). Dependencies: Task 1-6
